Detailed Description

A scene-level sensor (not attached to any bot).

Useful for environment-level observations such as overhead cameras, force plates, or proximity sensors mounted on fixtures.

◆ inputs

DynamicArray<DynamicString> superdex::robotics::SceneSensorEntry::inputs

Canonical sensor graph inputs.

Use bot/link/sensor for a bot-owned node and the scene sensor's own name for a scene-owned node. Scene sensors have no bot/link context for shortening.
